scope: Resolve reachable transaction ancestry by txid from the same original strict-framed BEEF. No wallet, SDK, source input report, storage record, funding or native execution is modified. Default corpus2 and its spends operation remain unchanged.

acceptance.subject: Exact requested txid equals the Atomic BEEF subject, or the last subject of non-atomic BEEF.
acceptance.closure: Every reachable parent has full bytes in this single request; no cross-report, fixture or network supplementation.
structure: raw transaction hash agrees with indexed txid
no conflicting spends across the reachable graph
maximum64 edges to the pinned proof, including memoized paths
cryptography: every unmined input script validates against its exact parent output
checked input/output arithmetic and nonnegative fee
exact Merkle root and height for every terminal proof
acceptance.negativeControl: Mutated subject output reaches the same signature and value predicates and must fail. Subject binding is updated to the actual mutation txid; evidence input bytes remain unchanged.

historicalPolicy: Original corpus2 results remain immutable. A fresh corpus3 result has a distinct identity and complete source/input hashes. It cannot retroactively replace a failed corpus2 report or imply that a native scenario was rerun.
